source: Doring, Oset, Strottman, Physical Review C 73, 045209 (2006)
panel: E_gamma=1.7 GeV, M(eta p), lower right
trace_method: Independent visual trace of the solid stroke in a 600 dpi Poppler render; values read to 0.1 microbarn/GeV, no calculated curve consulted.
ambiguity: Solid and dashed strokes approach or overlap around 1.60 and above 1.72 GeV. A conservative 2.0 microbarn/GeV reading bound covers stroke width, manual location and line assignment there. The 1.80 GeV point is the allowed ceiling; no farther tail is traced.
